thread:
alex: noticed customer errors for long prompts after the v3 generator rollout. truncation + 400s showing up in logs. low percentage but consistent. recommending hotfix: pin generator image back.
devon (sre): logs show tokenizer buffer overflow on 2 pods. agree pin. need oncall or release signoff to bypass canary.
rita (oncall): i'm available. what's the target image? and rollback command?
alex: target: `redwood/generator:v2.9.1-stable` current: `redwood/generator:v3-20260401-rc3` command: `helm upgrade generator ./charts/generator --set image.tag=v2.9.1-stable --namespace prod && kubectl rollout status deploy/generator -n prod -w` also recommend flipping feature flag: `ffctl set generator_v3_enabled false`
release-coordinator: pinging product for expedited approval @samir. this would bypass the 30m canary.
samir (prod): product sees impact on a small subset of long-prompt customers. if it's just the model binary and not inference schema, +1 for expedited pin. leave release note text please.
alex: requesting deploy-bot bypass with reason: "generator truncation regression; low blast; revert to stable binary"
deploy-bot: [automation] Received bypass request from alex. Canary gates: p95 latency, error-rate. Current canary: p95 +30%, errors 0.6% (<gate). Need explicit approvals from `rita` and `samir`.
rita (oncall): +1; i'll run the rollout and monitor.
ops-bot: running preflight checks: cluster load, node memory, disk IO. preflight OK.
deploy-bot: approvals present. scheduling in 45s. tagging stakeholders.
(dev window) rita (oncall): applying helm upgrade now. watching pods come up.
deploy-bot: rollout event: generator image -> redwood/generator:v2.9.1-stable, pods 6/6 ready.
devon (sre): quick smoke: tokenization errors gone in logs, 200s restored for long prompts.
rita (oncall): holding for 5m window. watching p95 and error rate. notify if >1% error.
alex: creating ENG-1601 to track RCA and tests to cover long prompts. will add unit tests for tokenizer buffer checks.
release-coordinator: release note draft: "hotfix: reverted generator to v2.9.1-stable due to truncation for long prompts observed in v3 rollout; follow-up RCA and tests planned."
samir (prod): approved expedited action and release note. please attach customer impact matrix.
ops-bot: monitor window complete. metrics stable. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
alex: thanks everyone. will follow up with postmortem and rollout checklist for next attempt at v3
